item.title: Blue House senior aide: "More important to address policy measures than to dismiss Kim Yong-beom" (靑 홍보수석 “김용범 경질보다 대책 챙기는 게 중요”)
item.description:
Blue House senior aide: "More important to address policy measures than to dismiss Kim Yong-beom" (靑 홍보수석 “김용범 경질보다 대책 챙기는 게 중요”)

Cheong Wa Dae senior communications secretary Sung Ki-hong said on the 6th, amid the growing calls for the dismissal of Policy Planning Chief Kim Yong-beom following the introduction of single-stock leveraged exchange-traded funds (ETFs), "At this point, it is more important to carefully monitor the market and work on countermeasures." This drew a line under the speculation about Kim's dismissal. (성기홍 청와대 홍보소통수석은 6일 단일 종목 레버리지 상장지수펀드(ETF) 도입 이후 불거진 ‘김용범 정책실장 경질론’에 “지금은 시장을 일단 유의 깊게 살피면서 대책을 챙기는 게 더 중요하다”고 밝혔다. 김 실장 경질론에 선을 그은 것이다.)

Appearing on CBS Radio that day, Sung said, "Not only is the volatility (in both the stock market and real estate) high, but the impact on people's livelihoods is also very significant." He added, "In that regard, not only Chief Kim but all Cheong Wa Dae officials are meticulously reviewing all of these matters, and we are very carefully examining what the causes are and how to prepare countermeasures." Sung also stated, "I would like to note that the government is sensitively monitoring stock market trends and responding responsibly." (성 수석은 이날 CBS 라디오에 출연해 “모두(증시와 부동산) 휘발성이 클 뿐 아니라 민생에 미치는 영향도 매우 크다”며 “그런 점에서 김 실장은 물론이고 청와대 당국자 모두가 이 모든 사항을 꼼꼼하게 점검하고 있고, 현재 원인이 무엇이고 대책을 어떻게 마련할 것인가 굉장히 세심하게 살펴보고 있다”고 했다. 성 수석은 “정부도 주식 시장 동향을 예민하게 살펴보면서 책임감 있게 대응하고 있다는 점을 말씀드린다”고 덧붙였다.)

Regarding the government's real estate policies, including the tax reform proposal, he said, "The goal of this real estate tax reform is to rationalize the real estate tax system," adding, "As President Lee Jae-myung has repeatedly stated, the government has no intention of trying to bring down housing prices through taxes." Sung said, "We are currently exploring multifaceted measures, including expanding housing supply and rationalizing housing finance," and added, "We plan to present policies to the public, including the supply issue, as soon as possible." (정부의 세제 개편안을 비롯한 부동산 정책에 대해서는 “이번 부동산 세제 개편의 목표는 부동산 세제를 합리화하는 것”이라며 “이재명 대통령도 누차 밝혔다시피 정부는 세금으로 집값을 잡겠다는 생각은 갖고 있지 않다”고 했다. 성 수석은 “주택 공급 확대와 주택 금융 합리화 등에 대한 다각적 대책을 현재 강구 중”이라며 “가급적 빠른 시일 내에 국민들께 공급 문제까지 포함해 정책을 내놓을 예정”이라고 했다.)

On the timing of the policy announcement, Sung said, "The timing has not been finalized yet, but we will announce it as soon as possible, without unnecessary delay." Regarding concerns that the tax reform plan would add pressure to the jeonse (lump-sum deposit) and monthly rental markets, he said, "We are listening to media reports, criticisms, and the voices of the people," and added, "There are concerns that tax burdens could be passed on to rents in the short term, reducing available jeonse and monthly rental listings, but institutional safeguards for tenant protection are already in place." (정책 발표 시점에 대해 성 수석은 “시기는 아직 확정되지 않았지만 가급적 늦지 않은 시간 내, 빠른 시일 내 발표하도록 하겠다”고 했다. 세제 개편안으로 전·월세 시장에 부담이 가중된다는 지적에는 “언론의 보도나 지적, 또 국민의 목소리에 귀를 기울이고 있다”며 “단기적으로 (세 부담이) 임대료로 전가되면서 전·월세 매물이 감소될 거라는 우려가 있는데, 세입자 보호를 위한 제도적 장치는 마련된 것들이 있다”고 했다.)

Sung said, "Going forward, the government will expand public rental housing supply for the stability of the jeonse and monthly rental markets and continue to promote measures to ease housing cost burdens for young people and those without homes." (성 수석은 “앞으로 정부는 전·월세 안정을 위해 공공 임대 공급을 확대하고 청년이나 무주택자에 대한 주거비 부담 완화 방안을 지속적으로 추진할 것”이라고 했다.)

item.title: US Rethinking Nuclear Strategy Against China and Russia? "Discussion of New Strategy Emphasizing Short-Range Tactical Nukes" (美, 中·러 맞서 核전략 다시 짜나… “단거리 전술핵 강조 새 전략 논의”)
item.description:
US Rethinking Nuclear Strategy Against China and Russia? "Discussion of New Strategy Emphasizing Short-Range Tactical Nukes" (美, 中·러 맞서 核전략 다시 짜나… “단거리 전술핵 강조 새 전략 논의”)

The U.S. Department of Defense is developing a new nuclear weapons strategy to prepare for potential attacks by China and Russia, NBC reported on the 5th. Instead of long-range strategic nuclear weapons, which are extremely unlikely to actually be used in the event of a regional war, the aim is to reshape the nuclear strategy to place greater emphasis on short-range tactical nukes that can actually be launched against key targets. This move is being led by Elbridge Colby, the under secretary of defense for policy, who is the de facto architect of defense policy, and if actually adopted, it is expected to have a significant impact on the security landscape of Indo-Pacific allies such as South Korea and Japan. <<> Colby gave a closed-door speech that day at the "2026 Deterrence Symposium" held at U.S. Strategic Command (STRATCOM) in Omaha, Nebraska. STRATCOM is the key functional combatant command responsible for overseeing the U.S. nuclear force operations worldwide, strategic deterrence, and space and cyberspace defense. It also has the mission of providing "extended deterrence" (nuclear umbrella) capabilities to allies including South Korea. Citing sources, NBC reported that the new nuclear strategy proposed by Colby is designed to address scenarios in which U.S. allies come under attack by China or Russia in regional conflicts. A senior U.S. Department of Defense official told the press, "Our view is that we need credible nuclear options," explaining that this strategy would broaden the range of choices and contribute to strengthening deterrence. <<> Tactical nuclear weapons are weapons designed to achieve victory on the battlefield by striking limited, specific targets such as enemy front-line units or bases. In contrast, strategic nuclear weapons are differentiated as weapons that bring an end to war itself or devastate nations through their massive destructive power. Colby has long supported tactical nukes equipped with small, short-range warheads that target specific small-scale targets on the battlefield rather than entire cities such as capitals. This is because while long-range strategic weapons can destroy an adversary's nuclear forces, they are not seen as actually usable, which undermines allied confidence in the U.S. extended deterrent. A representative example is the recurring question raised domestically amid the growing North Korean nuclear and missile threat whenever arguments for nuclear armament emerge: "Would the U.S. really sacrifice Los Angeles (LA) for Seoul?" U.S. Forces Korea operated tactical nuclear weapons from 1958 to 1991, and they were fully withdrawn in accordance with the "Joint Declaration on the Denuclearization of the Korean Peninsula." <<> A U.S. Department of Defense official said, "If you want extended deterrence to be credible, you need to provide the political leadership of that country with nuclear forces that are sensible enough to be actually used." However, there are also criticisms that placing greater emphasis on tactical nukes could lower the threshold for nuclear use, increasing the risk of nuclear weapons being employed in conventional conflicts, and that in scenarios requiring the deployment of long-range nuclear weapons, it could lead the U.S. president to make different choices, thereby further weakening readiness. Colby faced considerable friction with Congress last year while drafting new documents such as the National Defense Strategy (NDS), with one senior congressional figure saying, "It's a study that is very far removed from President Trump's stated position of making nuclear deterrence great again." (미 국방부가 중국과 러시아의 잠재적 공격에 대비하기 위한 새로운 핵무기 전략을 수립하고 있다고 NBC가 5일 보도했다. 지역 전쟁 발발 시 실제로 사용할 가능성이 극도로 낮은 장거리 전략 핵무기 대신, 실제로 주요 표적을 향해 발사할 수 있는 단거리 전술핵에 더 큰 비중을 두는 방향으로 핵전략을 다시 짜려 한다는 것이다. 이런 움직임은 국방 정책의 실질적 입안자인 엘브리지 콜비 정책 담당 차관이 주도하고 있는데, 실제로 채택될 경우 인도·태평양 지역 동맹인 한국과 일본의 안보 지형에도 상당한 영향이 있을 것으로 보인다.)

item.title: Jang Dong-hyuk: "Lee Claims He Hasn't Read Criminal Procedure Act... Is He Really the President? I Wonder What's Going On in His Mind" (장동혁 “형소법 안 읽었다는 李... 대통령 맞나, 정신세계가 궁금”)
item.description:
Jang Dong-hyuk: "Lee Claims He Hasn't Read Criminal Procedure Act... Is He Really the President? I Wonder What's Going On in His Mind" (장동혁 “형소법 안 읽었다는 李... 대통령 맞나, 정신세계가 궁금” )

People Power Party leader Jang Dong-hyuk on the 6th, referring to President Lee Jae-myung's remarks the previous day that he "hasn't read the revised Criminal Procedure Act," said, "Is he really our president? Should we even acknowledge him as president?" (국민의힘 장동혁 대표가 6일 전날 “개정된 형사소송법을 안 읽어봤다”고 언급한 이재명 대통령을 향해 “우리나라 대통령 맞느냐. 우리가 대통령으로 인정해야 되느냐”고 했다.)

At a Supreme Council meeting held that morning at the National Assembly, Jang said, "The president is spewing unprecedented reckless remarks, but he does so so calmly and nonchalantly that the public can hardly even recognize them as reckless." (장 대표는 이날 오전 국회에서 최고위원회의를 열고 “대통령이 역대급 망언을 쏟아내고 있는데 너무 태연하게 아무렇지도 않게 망언을 쏟아내고 있어서 국민들은 이게 망언인지조차 느끼기 어려울 정도”라며 이같이 말했다.)

He continued, "The entire nation has been in an uproar over this revision to the Criminal Procedure Act that abolishes supplementary investigative powers. Over 60% of the public still opposes it. The victim of the Busan 'spin-kick' case even created a new X account and posted a heartfelt plea to the president saying, 'You must not abolish supplementary investigative powers'—and this is how the president responded." (그는 “보완수사권을 폐지하는 이 형사소송법 개정안 때문에 대한민국 전체가 떠들썩했다”며 “60% 넘는 국민이 아직도 반대하고 있다. 부산 돌려차기 피해자가 X(엑스) 계정을 새로 만들어서 대통령에게 ‘보완수사권을 폐지하면 안 된다’고 절절한 글을 올렸는데 대통령이 이렇게 발언한 것”이라고 했다.)

He added, "I'm curious about President Lee's current state of mind. What did he mean by saying that? I can't even begin to analyze it." Jang also said, "No matter how I think about it, this Criminal Procedure Act revision is something that simply cannot be allowed to exist. It's an irresponsible act of dodging responsibility by claiming he passed it without properly reviewing the legal text, fearing he'd be remembered as a sinner in history." (그러면서 “이 대통령의 지금 정신 세계가 궁금하다. 어떤 의미로 이 말을 했을까. 분석조차 잘 되지 않는다”고 했다. 장 대표는 “아무리 생각해봐도 도저히 있을 수 없는 형사소송법 개정안이기에 두고두고 역사에 죄인으로 남을까 봐 법조문을 잘 안 보고 통과시켰다고 책임을 회피하는 무책임한 모습”이라고 했다.)

Jang said, "A president who meticulously searches news articles down to every comma and period and demands posts be deleted from X, a president who even monitors party members' comments to engage in online spats with them over party affairs—this same president says he didn't look at the Criminal Procedure Act revision. So what, does that mean he has no interest in the people or the country? Is it 'I only care about myself,' 'I have no interest in anything but myself'? What is this?" (장 대표는 “언론 기사는 쉼표, 마침표까지 일일이 검색해서 X에 기사를 삭제하라고 살피는 대통령이, 당무 개입에 대해서는 당원의 댓글까지 일일이 살펴서 당원과 SNS에서 말싸움까지 하는 대통령이 형사소송법 개정안은 보지 않았다고 말한 것”이라며 “그렇다면 국민은, 나라는 관심 없고 ‘나는 나밖에 모른다’ ‘나는 나 외에는 관심이 없다’ 뭐 이것이냐”고 했다.)

He then said, "It's deplorable." Jang added, "Justice Minister Jung Sung-ho said the Criminal Procedure Act revision was pushed through at the speed of light. If the Lee Jae-myung regime and the Democratic Party revised the Criminal Procedure Act at the speed of light, and if the president didn't even bother to read a single provision of it, then ultimately the regime will collapse at the speed of light." (그러면서 “참담하다”고 했다. 장 대표는 “정성호 법무부 장관이 형사소송법 개정안에 대해 빛의 속도로 개정됐다고 했다”며 “이재명 정권이, 더불어민주당이 형사소송법을 빛의 속도로 개정했다면 그리고 대통령이 그 형사소송법 법조문을 읽어보지도 않았다면 결국 정권이 빛의 속도로 무너질 것”이라고 했다.)

Earlier, during a briefing from the Ministry of Justice and the Ministry of the Interior and Safety the previous day, President Lee Jae-myung asked about the Criminal Procedure Act revision that entirely abolishes prosecutors' direct investigative authority, saying, "I haven't read the revised Criminal Procedure Act, but does it say prosecutors must not conduct investigations under the revised law?" This sparked controversy, as it was interpreted that the president—just one day after passing the revision in a Cabinet meeting—claimed he "hadn't read" it and asked about the core issue of whether prosecutors can investigate. (앞서 이재명 대통령은 전날 법무부와 행정안전부의 업무 보고를 받으면서 검찰의 직접 수사권을 전면 폐지한 형사소송법 개정안에 대해 “저는 개정된 형소법을 안 읽어봐서 그런데, 개정된 형소법에 의하면 검사는 수사하면 안 된다고 되어 있느냐”라고 물었다. 이 대통령이 국무회의에서 해당 개정안을 통과시킨 지 하루 만에 개정안을 ‘안 읽어봤다’면서 핵심 사안인 검사의 수사 가능 여부에 관해 물은 것으로 해석되며 논란이 됐다.)

However, Cheong Wa Dae Senior Secretary for Public Relations and Communication Sung Ki-hong appeared on CBS radio that day to manage the fallout, saying, "The president is, of course, fully aware of the overall intent and core content of the Criminal Procedure Act revision. I understand those remarks came out in the process of him asking questions about the joint prosecution-police investigation headquarters." Sung explained, "Yesterday's remarks were made in the context of instructing that prosecutors and police prepare for all possible scenarios that could arise under the new legal framework, ensuring there is no inconvenience to the public's lives going forward." (다만 성기홍 청와대 홍보소통수석은 이날 CBS 라디오에 나와 “(이 대통령이 형소법 개정안에 대해) 전반적인 취지라든지 핵심 내용을 당연히 충분히 숙지하고 계시다”며 “검·경 합동수사본부의 내용을 묻고 질문하는 과정에서 그 발언들이 나온 걸로 이해한다”며 진화에 나섰다. 성 수석은 “새로운 법체계를 통해 형성될 수 있는 모든 가능한 경우에 검찰이나 경찰이 대비하라, 앞으로 과정에서 국민의 삶에 불편함이 없도록 준비해야 한다는 차원에서 어제 발언이 나온 것”이라고 밝혔다.)

item.title: Kim Min-seok: "If There Were No Myung-Cheong Conflict, Would I Have Quit as Prime Minister?" (김민석 “명청갈등 없다면 총리 그만뒀겠나”)
item.description:
Kim Min-seok: "If There Were No Myung-Cheong Conflict, Would I Have Quit as Prime Minister?" (김민석 “명청갈등 없다면 총리 그만뒀겠나”)

<<>> ()

Kim Min-seok, a candidate for the leader of the Democratic Party of Korea, claimed on the 6th that a conflict between President Lee Jae-myung and candidate Chung Cheong-rae indeed exists, saying, "If there were no conflict between the Myung faction and the Cheong faction, why would I have stepped down as prime minister and come out?" ()

Appearing on Kim Eo-jun's YouTube channel that day, the candidate said, "It is an uncomfortable truth that the level of close coordination that should naturally take place between the party and the presidential office has not actually been working well." He also targeted Chung, who has not made a separate statement regarding Yoo Si-min's recent criticism of President Lee, claiming Chung is showing anti-Myung behavior. (김민석 더불어민주당 당대표 후보는 6일 “명청대전과 갈등이 없으면 뭐 하러 총리를 그만두고 나왔겠느냐”며 이재명 대통령과 정청래 후보 사이의 갈등이 실제 존재한다고 주장했다.)

Regarding Yoo Si-min's remarks, he said, "It defies common sense that someone at the level of Chung Cheong-rae or Kim Min-seok would not say a single word while former Minister Yoo Si-min is shaking the president," and added, "Even what I've mentioned already amounts to more than 10 grounds (for defining Chung as anti-Myung). Are you calling this pro-Myung?" (김 후보는 이날 김어준씨 유튜브 채널에 나와 “당청 간에 당연히 이뤄져야 할 수준의 긴밀한 조율이 실제로 잘되지 않은 것은 불편한 진실”이라고 했다. 또 유시민씨가 최근 이 대통령을 비판한 데 대해 별도 입장 표명을 하지 않은 정 후보를 겨냥해 반명 행보를 보이고 있다고 주장했다.)

The candidate said, "If the party and the government are shaken, what happens immediately? Before the election, everything looks fine, but after the election, the party's approval rating drops, the president's approval rating drops, and the stock market wavers, right? Isn't this about keeping people like Oh Se-hoon and Han Dong-hoon—who are utterly unqualified—alive as presidential contenders? Aren't those who should be sent home for insurrection now full of swagger?" (그는 유시민씨 발언에 대해서도 “정청래나 김민석 정도가 유시민 전 장관이 대통령을 흔드는데 말을 한마디 안 한다는 건 상식이 아니다”라며 “제가 말씀드린 것만 해도 (정 후보가 반명으로 규정될 근거가) 10개가 넘는데 이걸 친명이라고 얘기하느냐”라고 했다.)

He continued, "We're going through all this chaos and holding the party convention, but if Chung becomes the leader again just like last year, what would people think? Wouldn't they say, 'Now even if the former minister openly shakes the president, no one will check him'?" He added, "The most important thing is the mega-project, and (the government's policies) everything could be thrown into turmoil." (김 후보는 “당정이 흔들리고, 당이 흔들리면 당장 어떻게 되겠느냐. 선거 전엔 멀쩡하다가 선거 후엔 당 지지율이 떨어지고, 대통령 지지율이 떨어지고, 증시가 흔들리지 않느냐”라며 “오세훈·한동훈 같은 택도 안 되는 (이들을) 대권주자라고 둘을 살려놓은 거 아니냐. 내란으로 집에 가야 할 사람들이 지금 기가 산 것 아니냐”라고 했다.)

When Kim Eo-jun asked whether the mega-project could be shaken depending on who becomes party leader, the candidate replied, "Objectively, that's true. I believe it will be shaken if Chung becomes leader. Would the party function properly?" (이어 “지금 이 난리를 치고 전당대회를 치르고 있는데 똑같이 작년처럼 정 후보가 된다면 사람들이 어떻게 생각하겠나. ‘이제 유 전 장관이 대놓고 대통령을 흔들어도 누구도 견제도 안 하겠구나’라고 하지 않겠나”라며 “가장 중요한 게 메가프로젝트인데 (정부의 정책) 모든 것이 흔들릴 수 있다”고 했다.)

The candidate also brought up the process of discussing the abolition of the prosecution's supplementary investigation powers. He said, "The president said let's deliberate on it, but (Chung) kept striking it down every time, and when it came time to wrap it up in April, he delayed it again. Frankly, I believe (Chung) intended to drag this issue out until the party convention. There's no other way to make sense of it." (김 씨가 ‘당대표가 누구냐에 따라 메가프로젝트가 흔들릴 수 있느냐’라는 취지로 묻자 김 후보는 “객관적으로 사실이다. 저는 정 대표가 되면 흔들린다고 본다”며 “당이 제대로 돌아가겠는가”라고 답했다.)

Regarding the raising of the Shincheonji allegations, the candidate said, "I'm someone who even warned about the martial law in advance—would I have brought this up out of nowhere? There is sufficient basis to raise the issue." As for Chung's announcement of an ethics inspection, he said, "It's not justified, and would that achieve party unity?" (김 후보는 검찰 보완수사권 폐지 논의 과정도 거론했다. 그는 “대통령은 숙의해서 하자고 했는데 매번 바로 쳐버렸고, 막상 4월에 끝내자고 하니 그때는 또 지연했다”며 “솔직히 말씀드리면 (정 후보가) 전당대회 때까지 이 이슈를 끌고 오려고 했다고 본다. 그렇지 않고서는 이해가 안 된다”고 했다.)

On future relations with the Rebuilding Korea Party, the candidate said, "I'm probably the person who most urged former leader Cho Kuk to quickly join the Democratic Party and engage in politics." He added, "Whether it's a merger, an alliance, or competing as candidates of another party, ultimately it's a matter of competitiveness. The question is how many candidates (the Rebuilding Korea Party) has who can break through that competitiveness." (김 후보는 신천지 의혹 제기에 대해선 “제가 계엄도 (미리 경고를) 했던 사람인데 생짜 아무 얘기도 없이 했겠느냐”라며 “문제를 얘기할 정도의 근거는 충분히 나와 있다”고 했다. 정 후보가 윤리감찰을 예고한 데 대해선 “타당하지도 않고 당의 통합이 되겠느냐”라고 했다.)

Regarding predictions for the upcoming primary, he said, "Looking at the final outcome, I believe there's a 99.99% chance the conclusion will come in a form where (my vote share) exceeds 50%, not through preference voting. That's where the convention is headed, and that's how the strategic choices of our support base will go." (김 후보는 향후 조국혁신당과의 관계를 두고는 “제가 사실 조국 전 대표에게 민주당에 빨리 합류해 정치를 하는 게 좋지 않겠냐고 가장 많이 권했던 사람일 것”이라며 “합당이건 연대를 하건, 다른 당의 후보로 경쟁하건 결국은 경쟁력의 문제다. 그 경쟁력을 돌파할 수 있는 (혁신당의) 후보자가 몇 명이나 되느냐 하는 문제”라고 했다.)

item.title: Democratic Party Leadership: "Real Estate Tax Reform Plan Is Rational... Stop the People Power Party's Distortion" (與지도부 “부동산 세제 개편안 합리적...국민의힘 왜곡 멈춰라”)
item.description:
Democratic Party Leadership: "Real Estate Tax Reform Plan Is Rational... Stop the People Power Party's Distortion" (與지도부 “부동산 세제 개편안 합리적...국민의힘 왜곡 멈춰라”)

The Democratic Party of Korea on the 6th described the government's real estate tax reform plan as "normalizing the tax system with a focus on genuine homebuyers," and criticized the People Power Party for opposing the plan, calling it "a misstep born of a lack of understanding." The government's real estate tax reform plan announced on the 3rd includes measures such as lowering the comprehensive real estate tax deduction for non-resident single-homeowners and restricting the long-term holding special deduction benefits for capital gains tax. (더불어민주당은 6일 정부의 부동산 세제 개편안에 대해 “실수요자 중심으로 세제를 정상화하는 것”이라며 개편안을 비판하는 국민의힘을 향해 “이해 부족으로 인한 헛발질”이라고 했다. 지난 3일 정부가 발표한 부동산 세제 개편안에는 비거주 1주택자의 종합부동산세(종부세) 공제액을 낮추고 양도세 장기보유특별공제 혜택을 제한하는 내용 등이 담겼다.)

Han Jung-ae, chair of the Democratic Party's policy committee, said at a policy coordination meeting held at the National Assembly that day, "(The real estate tax reform plan) is intended to robustly protect actual residents and enhance tax equity." She added, "Many citizens and media outlets have pointed out the distortion in the real estate market caused by the preference for 'one prime asset,' and this reform plan has been designed to differentiate benefits between owner-occupied homes and investment or speculative properties, thereby robustly protecting actual residents while normalizing the tax burden on high-priced homes." (한정애 민주당 정책위의장은 이날 국회에서 열린 정책조정회의에서 “(부동산 세제 개편안은) 실거주자를 두텁게 보호하고 과세형평을 제고하기 위한 것”이라며 “그동안 많은 국민과 언론에서 ‘똘똘한 한 채’ 선호로 인한 부동산 시장의 왜곡을 지적해 왔는데, 이번 개편안은 실거주 주택과 투자용 또는 투기용 주택에 대한 혜택을 차등화해 실거주자를 두텁게 보호하고, 고가주택에 대해서는 세부담을 정상화하는 방향으로 설계됐다”고 했다.)

She also said, "Sufficient grace periods have also been provided so that citizens can respond over time to any changes in tax burden that may arise during this tax normalization process. The conditions for payment deferral have also been relaxed, with consideration given to elderly people without income." (또 “이런 과세 정상화 과정에서 발생할 수 있는 세부담 변화에 국민들이 시간을 가지고 대응할 수 있도록 충분한 유예기간도 부여했다. 납부유예 요건도 완화해서 소득이 없는 고령자도 배려하고 있다”고 했다.)

She stated, "The government and the ruling party are well aware of the public's concerns regarding housing supply and the jeonse and monthly rent markets. We will listen more closely to the people's voices regarding the tax reform, examine the market impact down to the finest details, and consult together as the party and government," and added, "I want to assure you that we will carefully address the supply and financial aspects as well, centered on the expanded and reorganized party-level 'Housing Market Stabilization Task Force.'" (그는 “정부·여당은 주택 공급, 전월세 시장 등에 대한 국민의 우려를 잘 알고 있다. 세제 개편과 관련해 국민의 목소리에 더욱 귀 기울이고, 시장의 영향을 세부적인 부분까지 살피며 당정이 협의해 나가겠다”며 “확대·개편되는 당내 ‘주택시장안정화TF(태스크포스)’를 중심으로 공급·금융 부분까지 꼼꼼히 챙기겠다는 말씀을 드린다”고 했다.)

Cheon Jun-ho, the deputy chief of staff for parliamentary affairs, also said, "The People Power Party is distorting the government's tax reform plan and fueling public anxiety. Fear marketing for political strife does nothing to help the people." (천준호 원내운영수석부대표도 “국민의힘은 정부 세제개편안을 왜곡하며 국민의 불안을 키우고 있다. 정쟁을 위한 공포 마케팅은 국민에게 아무런 도움이 되지 않는다”고 했다.)

He continued, "The core of this reform plan is to correct the distorted tax system and normalize the tax code with a focus on genuine demand. The direction of the reform is to reasonably adjust the tax benefits that were concentrated on ultra-high-value multi-home ownership while lowering the tax burden for actual single-homeowner residents." He added, "Real estate policy must not become political fodder that stokes fear. Only accurate information and responsible policy competition can safeguard market trust and the public's housing stability. I urge the People Power Party to stop its baseless distortions and engage in responsible policy discussions." <<>> (이어 “이번 개편안의 핵심은 왜곡된 과세 체계를 바로잡고 실수요자 중심으로 세제를 정상화하는 것”이라며 “초고가 다주택 보유에 집중됐던 세제 혜택을 합리적으로 조정하고 실거주 1주택자 세부담은 낮추는 것이 개편의 방향”이라고 했다. 그는 “부동산 정책은 공포를 조장하는 정치 소재가 돼선 안 된다. 정확한 정보와 책임 있는 정책 경쟁만이 시장의 신뢰와 국민 주거안정을 지킬 수 있다”며 “국민의힘은 근거없는 왜곡을 멈추고 책임 있는 정책 논의에 나서기를 바란다”고 했다.)

item.title: Politicization of the military, self-preservation, kowtowing to the North... How they created a third-rate army (軍 정치화, 보신주의, 北 눈치… 삼류 군대 만들었다)
item.description:
Politicization of the military, self-preservation, kowtowing to the North... How they created a third-rate army (軍 정치화, 보신주의, 北 눈치… 삼류 군대 만들었다)

Recently, the reality of a military with crumbling discipline has been exposed in various places. It was confirmed that front-line units stood guard with unloaded rifles, with magazines removed. An absurd incident also occurred where, during a front-line drone operation, a friendly aircraft was nearly shot down due to a lack of information sharing. In the Marine Corps, weapons and live ammunition were taken off base, yet they failed to even grasp the situation for a long time. (최근 군기 빠진 군의 실태가 곳곳에서 드러나고 있습니다. 최전방 부대에선 탄창을 뺀 채 빈총으로 경계 근무를 선 사실이 확인됐습니다. 전방 무인기 작전 중 정보 소통 부재로 아군기를 격추할 뻔하는 어이없는 일도 벌어졌습니다. 해병대에선 총기와 실탄이 외부로 반출됐는데도 장시간 상황 파악조차 못 했습니다.)

During the Moon Jae-in administration as well, the military's front-line fence lines, naval bases, and the capital defense command were breached time and again. Out of deference to North Korea, not only ROK-U.S. exercises but even their own military training was frequently postponed, scaled down, or canceled. As a result, the military was criticized as "an army that doesn't train" and "an army that defends the country through dialogue with the enemy rather than through strength." (문재인 정부 때도 군은 전방 철책선과 해군기지, 수방사 등이 번번이 뚫렸습니다. 북한 눈치를 보느라 한미 훈련은 물론이고 자체 군사 훈련도 수시로 연기·축소·취소됐습니다. 그래서 ‘훈련하지 않는 군대’ ‘힘이 아니라 적과의 대화로 나라를 지키는 군대’라는 비판을 받았습니다.)

But now, concerns are being raised that under the Lee Jae-myung administration, which champions "pragmatism and security," the situation is getting worse rather than better. As the government pushes a policy of rapprochement with North Korea, ROK-U.S. exercises are being frequently scaled down and postponed. Despite North Korea's hostile policies, the military changed the Military Demarcation Line in a way favorable to the North. The military also belatedly announced North Korea's missile provocations. (그런데 ‘실용과 안보’를 앞세운 이재명 정부에서 상황이 나아지기는커녕 더 나빠지고 있다는 우려가 나옵니다. 정부가 대북 화해 정책을 앞세우면서 한미 훈련은 수시로 축소·연기되고 있습니다. 북한의 적대시 정책에도 불구하고 군은 우리 군사분계선을 북한에 유리하게 바꿨습니다. 북의 미사일 도발도 늑장 발표했습니다.)

Dissonance between South Korea and the U.S. is also growing over the transition of wartime operational control (OPCON). Conflicts have repeatedly flared up over the UN Command's DMZ management authority. There was even a public clash between ROK and U.S. military leaders over U.S. exercises in the West Sea. Nuclear negotiations with the U.S. and discussions on introducing nuclear-powered submarines are stagnating. Assessments are emerging that communication and cooperation between South Korea and the U.S. are increasingly weakening. (전시작전통제권 전환을 놓고 한미 간 불협화음도 커지고 있습니다. 유엔사의 DMZ 관리권을 놓고 걸핏하면 갈등이 불거졌습니다. 미군의 서해 훈련을 두고는 한미 군 수뇌부가 공개 충돌하기도 했습니다. 미국과의 원자력 협상과 원잠 도입 논의는 지지부진합니다. 한·미 간 소통과 협력이 갈수록 약화되고 있다는 평가가 나옵니다.)

With the government pushing a policy of appeasement toward North Korea, and with successive disciplinary actions against general officers and senior officials following the martial law incident, concerns are growing that the military is becoming increasingly politicized. Observers say the military appears fixated on aligning with the administration's agenda while kowtowing to North Korea. There is a strong impression that commanders, rather than enhancing operational capabilities and strengthening vigilance, are adopting a self-preserving, blame-avoiding mindset of "let's just avoid any incidents during our tenure." Concerns are mounting that the military, far from being reborn as an elite, technologically advanced strong force, is devolving into a third-rate army. (정부가 대북 유화 정책을 앞세우고, 계엄 사태에 따른 군 장성과 간부급 징계도 잇따르면서 군이 점점 정치화하는 것 아니냐는 우려가 커지고 있습니다. 정권과 코드를 맞추면서 북한 눈치 보기에 급급한 모습을 보인다는 것입니다. 군 지휘관들은 작전 능력을 높이고 경계를 강화하기보다는 ‘재임 중 사고만 피하자’는 식의 보신주의와 면피주의로 가고 있다는 인상이 짙습니다. 정예화·과학화된 강군(强軍)으로 거듭나기는커녕 삼류 군대로 전락하고 있다는 우려가 커지는 상황입니다.)

An unprecedented incident occurred on the 3rd when the commander of the 1st Corps, Han Ki-sung, a core force guarding the capital Seoul on the front lines, was removed from duty. Lieutenant General Han issued instructions to stand guard with unloaded weapons, removing magazines from K6 heavy machine guns and K4 rapid-fire grenade launchers. And that's not all. The 1st Corps also reportedly stood guard with empty K2 rifles, with ammunition removed. The Joint Chiefs of Staff initially denied this but later confirmed it to be true. (최전방에서 수도 서울을 지키는 핵심 전력인 1군단의 한기성 군단장이 지난 3일 직무 배제되는 이례적 사태가 벌어졌습니다. 한기성 1군단장은 K6 중기관총과 K4 고속유탄발사기 등에서 탄창을 빼고 빈총으로 경계 근무를 서라는 지침을 내렸습니다. 이뿐이 아닙니다. 1군단은 개인화기인 K2 소총에서도 총알을 뺀 채 빈총으로 경계를 섰다고 합니다. 합참은 애초 이를 부인했지만 뒤늦게 사실로 확인됐습니다.)

Why was such an absurd order given? reportedly, during his time as a division commander, an accidental discharge occurred toward North Korea during a weapons inspection. If the North had protested or higher-ups launched an investigation, it could have created a difficult situation. So, to avoid such an occurrence, the 1st Corps ordered guards to stand watch with magazines removed. In other words, they removed the bullets out of fear that bullets might fly toward the enemy. This not only makes rapid response difficult in emergencies but also endangers the lives of our soldiers. Yet the commander effectively disarmed the troops to avoid a headache-inducing situation. (왜 이런 어이없는 지시가 내려갔던 것일까요. 한 군단장은 사단장 시절 총기 점검 중 북으로 총이 오발되는 사고가 있었다고 합니다. 북한이 이에 항의하거나 상부에서 경위 조사에 나서면 곤란한 상황이 일어날 수 있었던 겁니다. 그래서 1군단에선 이런 일이 일어나는 걸 피하려고 탄창을 빼고 경계 근무를 서게 했다는 것입니다. 적에게 총알이 날아갈까 봐 총알을 뺐다는 얘기가 됩니다. 유사시 신속한 대응이 힘든 것은 물론이고 우리 병사의 목숨이 위태로울 수 있는 일입니다. 그런데 지휘관이 골치 아픈 상황을 피하려고 병사들을 무장해제시킨 꼴입니다.)

Lieutenant General Han was reportedly the first 1st Corps commander from the ROTC background and was a strong candidate for promotion to four-star general. He had even directly briefed President Lee Jae-myung on front-line警戒 situations. But fearing a mishap from an accidental discharge toward the North, he simply removed the ammunition entirely. There's a saying: "What matters most?" This is an act of forgetting the military's fundamental mission. Some are even saying, "This isn't just a 1st Corps problem." The Joint Chiefs of Staff didn't even know about this situation. (한 군단장은 첫 학군 출신 1군단장으로 대장 진급이 유력했다고 합니다. 이재명 대통령에게 직접 전방 지역 경계 상황을 브리핑하기도 했습니다. 그런데 대북 오발 사고가 나면 낭패를 볼 수 있으니 아예 총알을 빼버린 겁니다. ‘뭣이 중헌디’라는 말이 있죠. 군의 기본 임무를 망각한 행태입니다. “1군단만의 일도 아니다”라는 얘기까지 나옵니다. 합참은 이런 실태조차 파악하지 못하고 있었습니다.)

Following the misidentification controversy involving a U.S. drone, a similar incident occurred in the 1st Corps with our own drone. A captain in charge of operational intelligence failed to report U.S. drone operation information provided by the U.S. military to higher-ups, leading to the U.S. drone being mistaken for a North Korean drone. The military even launched an actual intercept operation. However, tracking failed, and no shootdown was attempted. (미군 무인기에 이어 우리 무인기 오인 식별 논란도 1군단에서 벌어졌습니다. 작전 정보를 담당하는 대위가 미군이 통보한 무인기 작전 정보를 상부에 보고하지 않아서 미군 무인기를 북 무인기로 오인했던 것입니다. 군은 실제 격추 작전에도 나섰습니다. 하지만 추적에 실패해 격추 시도는 하지 못했습니다.)

During the 1st Corps' own drone operation, the drone's altitude rose higher than planned, reportedly causing it to be mistaken for an unidentified drone. They couldn't even distinguish friend from foe. While individual fault may exist, there are also criticisms that problems lie in the ROK-U.S. communication and operational systems. (1군단 자체 무인기 작전 과정에서도 무인기 고도가 예정보다 높아지는 바람에 신원 미상 무인기로 오인하는 상황이 벌어졌다고 합니다. 피아 구분도 못한 것입니다. 개인의 잘못도 있겠지만 한미 간 소통이나 작전 체계에 문제가 있다는 지적이 나옵니다.)

In the Marine Corps, an incident involving the leakage of weapons and live ammunition occurred. On the 3rd, a Marine Corps officer was found dead from a gunshot wound at off-base housing in Pohang, North Gyeongsang Province. He appears to have taken a K1 submachine gun and live ammunition from the unit. However, the Marine Corps reportedly did not know about the weapon leakage for over 60 hours. Weapons management in the military is supposed to be among the strictest, yet a hole was punched here too. (해병대에선 총기·실탄 유출 사고가 벌어졌습니다. 지난 3일 경북 포항의 해병대 간부가 영외 숙소에서 총기로 숨진 채 발견됐는데요. 부대에서 K1 기관단총과 실탄을 가지고 나간 것으로 보입니다. 그런데 해병대는 총기 유출 사실을 60시간 넘게 몰랐다고 합니다. 군에서 총기 관리는 무엇보다 엄격한데 여기도 구멍이 뚫린 겁니다.)

President Lee Jae-myung said during a Ministry of National Defense briefing on the 5th, "Korea Military Academy (KMA) graduates staged coups three times, and responsibility was never held." He also said, "KMA graduates could stage another coup." This is interpreted as explaining the background for integrating the army, navy, and air force academies. (이재명 대통령은 5일 국방부 업무 보고에서 “육사 출신이 세 번이나 쿠데타를 했는데 한 번도 책임을 묻지 않았다”고 했습니다. 또 “육사 출신이 또 쿠데타를 할 수도 있다”고 했습니다. 육사·해사·공사 등 사관학교를 통합하는 배경을 설명한 것으로 해석됩니다.)

Despite strong opposition from various quarters, the military has pushed ahead with the integration of the army, navy, and air force academies. Criticisms included "Even the U.S., UK, and France don't do that" and "Isn't this just purging a KMA that's fallen out of favor?" Then President Lee pointed to the KMA's involvement in coups as the biggest reason for the integration. But the coups directly staged by KMA graduates occurred during the Park Chung-hee and Chun Doo-hwan governments. The martial law incident during the Yoon Suk-yeol government was different in nature from a coup. Questions are being raised about whether it's appropriate to hold the KMA responsible for a coup from 46 years ago and integrate the academies to prevent recurrence. (군은 그동안 각계의 거센 반대에도 육·해·공 사관학교 통합을 밀어붙였습니다. “미국·영국·프랑스도 그렇게 안 한다” “미운털 박힌 육사 처내기 아니냐”는 지적이 나왔습니다. 그런데 이 대통령이 사관학교 통합의 가장 큰 이유로 육사의 쿠데타 참여를 지적한 것입니다. 하지만 육사 출신이 직접 쿠데타를 일으킨 것은 박정희·전두환 정부 때였습니다. 윤석열 정부 때 계엄 사태는 쿠데타와는 성격이 다릅니다. 46년 전의 쿠데타를 두고 육사에 책임을 묻고 재발 방지를 위해 사관학교를 통합하는 것이 맞느냐는 의문이 제기됩니다.)

The controversy over the defense minister's desertion also shows no signs of dying down. Minister Ahn Kyu-baek has failed to clearly explain the allegations that he deserted during his compulsory service. He could simply disclose his military service records and undergo a correction process, but he's doing neither. This has led to criticisms such as "Isn't the desertion real?" "The minister has no authority," and "Can military reform really succeed?" (국방장관 탈영 논란도 사그라들지 않고 있습니다. 안규백 장관은 방위 복무 시절 탈영했다는 의혹에 대해 속 시원하게 해명을 못 하고 있습니다. 병적기록부를 공개하고 오류 정정 절차를 밟으면 되는데, 둘 다 하지 않고 있습니다. 이 때문에 “탈영이 사실 아니냐” “장관의 영이 안 선다” “군 개혁이 제대로 되겠느냐”는 지적이 나옵니다.)

Criticisms are also being raised that cracks have appeared in the military's vigilance posture against North Korea and the ROK-U.S. alliance system. During the Moon Jae-in administration, front-line fences were repeatedly breached by North Korean defectors and North Korean escapees, to the point that the term "knock defection" emerged. Naval bases and the capital defense command were also frequently infiltrated by drunks, the elderly, and protesters. ROK-U.S. joint exercises were also frequently postponed and scaled down out of deference to North Korea. Eventually, they were often replaced with computer simulation exercises. (군의 대북 경계 태세와 한미 연합 체제에도 균열이 생겼다는 지적이 나옵니다. 문재인 정부 땐 노크 귀순이라는 말이 나올 정도로 전방 책이 북 귀순자와 월북자 등에게 번번이 뚫렸습니다. 해군 기지와 수방사에도 취객·노인·시위대 등이 무단 침입하곤 했습니다. 한미 연합 훈련도 북한 눈치를 보느라 수시로 연기·축소됐습니다. 나중엔 아예 컴퓨터 시뮬레이션 연습으로 바뀌곤 했습니다.)

Under this administration, things are going a step further. The Joint Chiefs of Staff changed the Military Demarcation Line criteria in a way favorable to the North. When the North fired ballistic missiles around the June 25 anniversary (of the Korean War), the military only belatedly announced it, and only after the North itself had disclosed the fact. (그런데 이 정부 들어 한술 더 뜨는 상황이 되고 있습니다. 합참은 군사분계선 기준을 북측에 유리하게 바꿨습니다. 북이 6·25에 맞춰 탄도미사일을 쐈는데, 군은 북이 이 사실을 발표한 후에야 비로소 늑장 공개했습니다.)

A "martial law phobia" is now widespread throughout the military. If even the slightest suspicion of involvement in the martial law incident is raised, generals are being investigated, disciplined, or forced out in droves. While pushing to reclaim wartime OPCON unconditionally, the ROK-U.S. exercises needed for that purpose have been repeatedly scaled down and postponed. South Korea and the U.S. have clashed over the UN Command's DMZ management authority. ROK and U.S. military leaders publicly clashed over U.S. exercises in the West Sea. Following Minister Chung Dong-young's remarks about North Korea's uranium enrichment facilities, intelligence sharing with the U.S. was also halted. People are asking, "Has the cooperation framework between the ROK and U.S. militaries ever been this weakened?" (지금 군에는 ‘계엄 포비아’가 광범위하게 번져 있습니다. 계엄 연루 의혹이 조금이라도 제기되면 장성들이 줄줄이 수사·징계를 당하거나 옷을 벗었기 때문입니다. 전작권 회수를 강행하면서도 그에 필요한 한미 훈련은 잇따라 축소·연기했습니다. 유엔사의 DMZ 관리권 문제로 한미가 갈등을 빚었고요. 미군 서해 훈련을 놓고는 한미 군 수뇌부가 공개 충돌했습니다. 정동영 장관의 북한 우라늄 농축 시설 발언 이후 미국과 대북 정보 공유도 중단됐습니다. “한·미 양국 군 사이의 협력 체제가 이처럼 약화된 적이 있었느냐”는 말이 나옵니다.)

Because of this, the saying "even the Tang dynasty army would have no excuse" is circulating within military circles. The root cause can be found in the politicization of the military and self-preservationism. (이 때문에 군 주변에선 “당나라 군대라고 해도 할 말이 없다”는 얘기가 나옵니다. 그 근본 원인은 군의 정치화와 보신주의에서 찾을 수 있습니다.)

The core of a strong army lies in overwhelming operational capability, readiness against the enemy, and an indomitable will to fight and win. Among these, readiness against the enemy—that is, vigilance posture—is of paramount importance. There's a saying that operational failures may be forgiven, but failures in vigilance cannot be. (강군의 핵심은 압도적 작전 능력과 적에 대한 대비 태세, 싸워 이긴다는 불굴의 정신력입니다. 그중에서도 적에 대한 대비 태세, 즉 경계 태세는 무엇보다 중요합니다. 작전 실패는 용서해도 경계 실패는 용서할 수 없다는 말이 있을 정도입니다.)

Yet among our military leadership, a self-preserving, blame-avoiding culture has spread widely, where avoiding accidents or scandals is considered more important than performing well in operations or standing watch properly. The reasoning is that no matter how capable an officer or senior NCO is, they cannot survive once they become the subject of gossip or are involved in an incident. (그런데 우리 군 지휘부 사이에선 작전 잘하고 경계 잘 서는 것보다 사고나 구설을 피하는 게 가장 중요하다는 보신주의·면피주의가 광범위하게 번져 있습니다. 구설수에 오르거나 사고가 나면 아무리 유능한 장교와 간부도 버틸 수 없다는 이유입니다.)

The perception is also pervasive that one must align well with the administration's agenda to be promoted. The military can only properly fulfill its mission if it stays out of politics, but the politicization of the military is tending to grow worse. Kowtowing to North Korea is also a serious problem. Aligning with the government's appeasement policy toward the North has led to a widespread belief throughout the military that even minor clashes with North Korea must be avoided. (정권과 코드를 잘 맞춰야 승진할 수 있다는 인식도 팽배합니다. 군이 정치에서 벗어나야 본연의 임무를 제대로 수행할 수 있는데 군의 정치화가 갈수록 더 심해지는 경향입니다. 북한 눈치 보기도 심각합니다. 정부의 대북 유화 정책에 맞추다 보니 북한과 작은 충돌도 피해야 한다는 생각이 군 전체에 퍼져 있습니다.)

The unconditional push for OPCON transition is also adversely affecting ROK-U.S. security cooperation. The U.S. supports OPCON transition in principle but insists that the ROK military's capability to assume wartime operational control must first be verified. The government, however, insists on unconditionally taking back wartime OPCON as early as next year, or at least within its term. Yet it remains passive about the ROK-U.S. exercises that would enhance and verify operational command capabilities. Problems are erupting everywhere, but the presidential office says "there are no issues." Observers point out that with no sense of crisis and no leadership authority, it's inevitable that the military's discipline erodes and it becomes a weakened force. (무조건적인 전작권 전환 정책도 한미 안보 협력에 악영향을 주고 있습니다. 미국은 전작권 전환 자체는 찬성하지만 한국군이 전시 작전권을 넘겨받을 능력이 먼저 검증돼야 한다고 얘기합니다. 그런데 정부는 이르면 내년, 적어도 임기 중에 전작권을 무조건 넘겨받아야 한다고 주장합니다. 그러면서도 작전 지휘 능력을 높이고 이를 검증할 수 있는 한미 훈련에는 소극적입니다. 곳곳에서 문제가 터지는데 청와대는 “별문제가 없다”고 합니다. 위기감도 없고 영도 안 서니 군기 빠진 군대가 될 수밖에 없다는 지적이 나옵니다.)

item.title: Han Dong-hoon to Democratic Party figures over 'prosecution investigation rights abolition': "Roh Moo-hyun revenge marketing is a fiction" (한동훈, ‘검수완박’ 민주당 인사들에 “노무현 복수심 마케팅은 허구”)
item.description:
Han Dong-hoon to Democratic Party figures over 'prosecution investigation rights abolition': "Roh Moo-hyun revenge marketing is a fiction" (한동훈, ‘검수완박’ 민주당 인사들에 “노무현 복수심 마케팅은 허구”)

Independent lawmaker Han Dong-hoon on the 6th criticized the Democratic Party of Korea's push to completely abolish the prosecution's supplementary investigation powers, saying, "They have ruined even the judicial system because of personal vindictiveness." Regarding the Democratic Party figures' repeated acts of reporting at the grave of former President Roh Moo-hyun in Gimhae, South Gyeongsang Province, after handling the so-called 'prosecution investigation rights complete abolition' bill, he also said, "They have effectively admitted that Roh Moo-hyun revenge marketing matters more than the public interest in abolishing supplementary investigations." <<> Rep. Han made these remarks on Facebook that day, stating, "The Roh Moo-hyun marketing that has dominated Democratic Party politics for nearly 20 years is a fiction." He added, "Democratic Party members offer the abolition of supplementary investigations as if it were a trophy at the late president's grave," and "They are saying that vindictiveness for Democratic Party politicians is the fundamental motive behind abolishing supplementary investigations, which will cause suffering for the vast majority of the public." <<> Indeed, after the Criminal Procedure Act amendment bill, whose core is the abolition of the prosecution's supplementary investigation powers, passed the National Assembly plenary session, Democratic Party lawmaker Kim Yong-min presented the bill at the grave of the late President Roh in Bongha Village. On the 1st, Rep. Kim wrote on Facebook, "I have offered the Criminal Procedure Act amendment to your spirit," adding, "Mr. President Roh, you must be saying, 'Hey, feels great~!!!!' right?" <<> Earlier, lawmaker Chung Cheong-rae, during his tenure as party leader in March, visited the late President Roh's grave in Bongha Village after the bills establishing the public prosecution office and the major crimes investigation office passed, and said tearfully, "I report to you, Mr. President. The prosecution service is now abolished and will vanish into history." At the time, not only then-leader Chung but also the entire Democratic Party leadership, including floor leader Han Byeong-do, gathered in front of the grave. <<> Regarding this, Rep. Han pointed out, "The Roh Moo-hyun revenge marketing must stop now." At a briefing on the abolition of supplementary investigation powers held at the National Assembly on the 4th, he also said, "It is a fact that the late President Roh's family received hundreds of thousands of dollars in illegal funds and tens of billions of won in bribes from businessman Park Yeon-cha," and "It is wrong to embellish committing illegal acts as if they were grievances." <<> He added, "There are criticisms that the investigation process was flawed, but that does not change the fact that serious illegal acts occurred," and "In the past and in the future, if any president had committed illegal acts of that magnitude, it is only natural that they should be investigated." <<> As Democratic Party figures who had 'reported' at the late President Roh's grave in Bongha Village remained silent on this, Rep. Han said, "The reason the Democratic Party is acting as if they heard nothing and all staying quiet in unison is that they lack both the logic and the courage to refute," and "The judicial system ruined by a fictional personal vendetta must be restored." (무소속 한동훈 의원은 6일 더불어민주당이 추진한 검찰 보완 수사권 완전 폐지와 관련해 “사적(私的) 복수심 때문에 사법 시스템까지 망친 것”이라고 비판했다. 민주당 인사들이 이른바 ‘검수완박(검찰 수사권 완전 박탈)’ 법안을 처리한 이후 경남 김해시 노무현 전 대통령 묘역에서 잇따라 보고하는 행태에 대해서도 “보완 수사 폐지는 공익(公益)보다 노무현 복수심 마케팅이 중요하다고 실토한 것”이라고도 했다.)

item.title: Lee Faces Backlash Over Military Academy Coup Responsibility Remarks... Opposition Says "Closing Schools Under Guilt-by-Association Is Absurd" (李, 육사 쿠데타 책임론 후폭풍...野 “연좌제로 출신학교 폐교” 반발)
item.description:
Lee Faces Backlash Over Military Academy Coup Responsibility Remarks... Opposition Says "Closing Schools Under Guilt-by-Association Is Absurd" (李, 육사 쿠데타 책임론 후폭풍...野 “연좌제로 출신학교 폐교” 반발)

People Power Party lawmakers on the 6th unanimously pushed back against President Lee Jae-myung's move to hold the Korea Military Academy (KMA) accountable for the December 3 martial law declaration, asking, "Does it make any sense to shut down a school through guilt by association?" The previous day, President Lee said during a defense ministry briefing, "Every military coup in South Korea's history has been carried out by Korea Military Academy graduates, but have we ever held them accountable?" adding, "If we merge the (army, navy, and air force) academies, wouldn't the possibility of a coup also decrease?" <<> In response, former lawmaker Yoo Seong-min of the People Power Party wrote on Facebook the same day, directly stating, "President Lee is not qualified to be the commander-in-chief of the armed forces." He questioned, "Did a coup really happen because of the Military Academy as an institution?" adding, "By that logic, we should also abolish Seoul National University's law school and Chungam High School, which former President Yoon graduated from." <<> He continued, "The simplistic and ignorant mindset that 'abolishing the Military Academy will eliminate coups' is the same as saying 'Roh Moo-hyun's death was the prosecution's fault, so abolish the prosecution,'" and stressed, "While there were Military Academy graduates who led coups, there were also graduates who risked their lives to stop them—this must not be forgotten." <<> Lawmaker Yoon Sang-hyun called the collective responsibility claims against the Military Academy "nothing short of collective guilt reminiscent of guilt by association," insisting, "Responsibility should be assigned based on individual conduct, not attributed to one's alma mater or an entire group." He further noted, "A supreme commander who leads the military revealing distrust toward a specific group like the Military Academy does not help the morale of our troops either." <<> Lawmaker Kim Jaesub also criticized, saying, "The president is now saying he will hold all 'Military Academy graduates' accountable," and "This brands tens of thousands of officers guarding the front lines as potential traitors." He added, "If merging the military academies is necessary, persuade the public with its efficiency and rationality," and "It is pathetic to treat the entire Military Academy as a criminal organization and drag in coups from half a century ago to justify policy." <<> Party leader Jang Dong-hyuk said at a party meeting the same day, "President Lee has again come out with another outrageous remark of the century, saying 'merging the (army, navy, and air force) academies would reduce coup possibilities.'" He also brought up Defense Minister Ahn Gyu-baek's absence from his post and unloaded rifle guard duties at front-line units, calling the situation "a national defense scandal of this magnitude." (국민의힘은 6일 이재명 대통령이 육군 사관학교에 12·3 비상계엄에 대한 책임을 물은 데 대해 “연좌제 출신 학교를 폐교시키는 것이 말이 되느냐”면서 일제히 반발했다. 전날 이 대통령은 국방부 업무 보고에서 “지금까지 대한민국의 군사 쿠데타는 육군사관학교 출신들이 한 일인데, 거기에 대한 책임을 물은 적이 있나”라며 “(육·해·공군) 사관학교 통합을 하면 쿠데타 가능성도 줄어들지 않겠나”라고 했다.)

item.title: Lee: "Youth are becoming a vulnerable group... We must lower the threshold for universal support" (李 “청년들, 취약계층 돼 가... 보편지원 문턱 낮춰야”)
item.description:
Lee: "Youth are becoming a vulnerable group... We must lower the threshold for universal support" (李 “청년들, 취약계층 돼 가... 보편지원 문턱 낮춰야”)

President Lee Jae-myung said on the 6th, "We should actively consider reorganizing youth policies around the core areas of young people's lives, such as education and employment, income and assets, housing and marriage." (이재명 대통령은 6일 “청년 정책은 교육과 취업, 소득과 자산, 주거와 결혼 등 청년 삶의 핵심 영역을 중심으로 재편하는 걸 적극 검토해야겠다”고 밝혔다.)

The President made these remarks while presiding over a meeting of senior secretaries at the presidential office, saying, "Among the various national agenda items, one that needs to be accelerated is the youth measures." (이 대통령은 이날 청와대에서 수석보좌관회의를 주재해 “여러 국정과제 중 속도를 높여야 할 것 중 하나가 청년 대책”이라며 이같이 밝혔다.)

The President stated, "Young people are now almost becoming a vulnerable group," and added, "We need to meticulously reorganize policies to align with the life cycle of young people and maximize the synergy effects among support policies." (이 대통령은 “청년들이 지금 거의 취약계층이 돼 가고 있다”며 “청년의 생애주기에 맞게 정책을 촘촘히 정비하고 지원 정책 간 시너지 효과를 극대화 하는 노력이 필요하겠다”고 했다.)

Regarding the method of support, he said, "For areas where universal support is needed, lower the threshold of support so that more young people can benefit, and for areas where tailored support is needed, consider designing a thicker support system." (지원 방식에 대해선 “보편 지원이 필요한 부분은 지원 문턱을 낮춰 보다 많은 청년이 수혜받게 하고, 맞춤형 지원이 필요한 부분은 지원 체계를 두텁게 설계하는 방안을 고려해달라”고 했다.)

In particular, he referenced a recent case where some applicants experienced confusion due to an error in membership-type guidance during the screening process for the youth future savings account, saying, "Relevant authorities should closely monitor the situation to ensure no unjust victims arise, and when introducing new systems, they must make every effort to provide accurate information." (특히 최근 청년 미래 적금 심사 과정에서 가입 유형 안내 오류로 일부 신청자들이 혼란을 겪은 사례를 언급하며 “관계 당국은 부당한 피해자가 생기지 않도록 상황을 면밀히 살피고 새로운 제도 도입 때는 정확한 정보를 제공할 수 있도록 만전을 기해야 한다”고 했다.)

Regarding the record-breaking heatwave, the President said, "We must pool our efforts to improve infrastructure such as housing, water facilities, power grids, and heatwave response facilities in line with the climate disaster that has become the new normal," and added, "Please also consider reflecting plans for this in next year's budget proposal." (이 대통령은 기록적인 폭염과 관련해 “뉴노멀이 된 기후 재난 상황에 맞게 주거와 용수 시설, 전력망, 폭염 대응 시설 같은 인프라 개선에 힘을 모아야 하겠다”며 “이에 대한 계획들을 내년 예산안에 반영하는 것도 검토해 주기 바란다”고 말했다.)

The President said, "There should never be a situation where people's lives and deaths are determined by where they live or where they work," and emphasized, "We must concentrate all available administrative capacity on ensuring the safety of residents in vulnerable facilities such as goshiwon, jjokbang villages, and vinyl greenhouses, as well as workers at construction sites, in farming and fishing villages, and parking lots." (이 대통령은 “어디에 살고, 또 어디에서 일을 하느냐에 따라 국민의 생사가 좌우되는 일이 생겨서는 안 된다”며 “고시원, 쪽방촌, 비닐하우스 같은 취약 시설 거주 주민이나 공사 현장, 농어촌, 주차장 등에서 일하는 노동자의 안전에 가용한 행정력을 최대한 집중해야 한다”고 했다.)

He also reiterated a strong response to the spread of false and manipulated information. The President said, "Regarding incorrect reports or malicious information from home and abroad, do not miss even the smallest detail and have each ministry take responsibility to correct it," adding, "The basis for the public's judgment is ultimately information, and only when that information is objective and accurate can their judgments be accurate as well." He further stated, "Please respond sternly to the dissemination of fake or manipulated information intended to distort and manipulate public judgment, collective opinions, and public sentiment." (허위조작 정보 유포에 대한 강력 대응도 재차 강조했다. 이 대통령은 “국내외 잘못된 보도나 악의적 정보에 대해서는 작은 것 하나도 놓치지 말고 부처가 책임지고 바로잡아주기 바란다”며 “국민 판단의 근거는 결국 정보인데, 그 정보가 객관적이고 정확해야 판단도 정확해진다”고 했다. 그러면서 “국민 판단, 집단적 의견, 여론을 왜곡 조작하기 위해 가짜정보, 조작정보 유포 행위에 대해서는 엄정 대응해주기 바란다”고 했다.)

item.title: Navy Conducts Defense Drills Around Dokdo... Two Days After Japan Claims "Dokdo Is Japanese Territory" (해군, 독도 방어 훈련 실시…日 “독도는 일본 땅” 주장 이틀만)
item.description:
Navy Conducts Defense Drills Around Dokdo... Two Days After Japan Claims "Dokdo Is Japanese Territory" (해군, 독도 방어 훈련 실시…日 “독도는 일본 땅” 주장 이틀만 )

The Navy reportedly conducted undisclosed Dokdo defense drills in the East Sea on the afternoon of the 6th. The military's exercise comes amid repeated claims by the Japanese government in its first defense white paper released after the inauguration of the Ishiba Shigeru cabinet, reiterating that Dokdo is its inherent territory. (해군이 6일 오후 동해에서 독도 방어 훈련을 비공개로 실시한 것으로 알려졌다. 최근 일본 정부가 다카이치 사나에(高市早苗) 내각 출범 이후 발간한 첫 방위백서에서 독도가 자국 고유 영토란 주장을 되풀이한 상황에서 우리 군이 훈련에 나선 것이다.)

According to military authorities on the 6th, the Navy conducted the East Sea Territory Defense Exercise in waters near Dokdo about eight months after the previous drill in December last year. A military source said, "The exercise method and scale of participating forces in this East Sea Territory Defense Exercise were similar to past drills," adding, "It was conducted to respond to threats against our territory, people, and assets." The exercise involved the Navy, Coast Guard, and the Dokdo Guard Unit, with surface vessel forces and scale reportedly similar to previous years' drills. (6일 군 당국에 따르면 해군은 지난해 12월 훈련 이후 약 8개월 만에 독도 인근 해상에서 동해영토수호훈련을 실시했다. 군 소식통은 “이번 동해영토수호훈련 훈련방식·참가전력 규모는 과거 훈련과 유사한 수준”이라며 “우리 영토·국민·자산에 대한 위협에 대응하기 위해 시행했다”고 했다. 이번 훈련에는 해군·해경·독도경비대 등이 참가했고 수상함 전력 및 규모는 예년 훈련과 비슷한 것으로 전해졌다.)

The military maintains that this exercise was routine in nature, not a response to Japan's defense white paper. The Navy's Dokdo defense drills began in 1986 and have been conducted regularly, typically twice a year, since 2003. However, the scale and frequency of the drills have sometimes been adjusted depending on South Korea-Japan relations. In 2019, during the Moon Jae-in administration, after Japan retaliated economically by removing South Korea from its "whitelist" (preferred export screening countries) in response to the Supreme Court's ruling on forced labor compensation, the military deployed Aegis destroyers and Army Special Forces to the Dokdo defense drills for the first time. (이번 훈련은 일본 방위백서에 대응하는 성격이 아닌 정례적이라는 것이 군의 입장이다. 해군의 독도 방어 훈련은 1986년 시작됐다. 2003년부터 통상 한해 두 차례씩 정례적으로 실시하고 있다. 다만 한일 관계에 따라 훈련 규모 및 횟수는 조정되곤 했다. 문재인 정부였던 2019년 일본은 한국 대법원의 강제징용 배상 판결에 반발해 한국을 ‘화이트리스트’(수출심사 우대국)에서 제외하는 등 경제보복 조치를 했는데 당시 군은 이지스구축함과 육군 특전사를 최초로 독도 방어 훈련에 투입했다.)

In this year's defense white paper released on the 4th following a cabinet meeting, the Japanese government stated, "The territorial issues of the Northern Territories (Japan's term for the four Kuril Islands) and Takeshima (Japan's name for Dokdo), which are our country's inherent territory, remain unresolved." In Japan, "inherent territory" refers to land that has never been under foreign control. Japan has continued to assert sovereignty over Dokdo through its defense white papers for 22 consecutive years since 2005. In response, the South Korean government summoned officials from the Japanese Embassy in Seoul and the Japanese defense attaché on the 4th to lodge a protest. (일본 정부는 지난 4일 각의(국무회의) 이후 발표한 올해 방위백서에 “우리나라(일본) 고유 영토인 북방영토(쿠릴 4개 섬의 일본식 표현)와 다케시마(竹島·일본이 주장하는 독도 명칭) 영토 문제가 여전히 미해결 상태로 존재한다”고 적었다. 일본에서 고유 영토는 한 번도 외국 영토가 된 적이 없는 땅이라는 의미로 쓰인다. 일본은 2005년 이후 22년 연속 방위백서를 통해 독도 영유권 주장을 지속했다. 이와 관련해 우리 정부는 지난 4일 주한일본대사관 관계자와 일본 방위주재관을 초치해 항의한 바 있다.)

item.title: Democratic Party: "Representative Jang Dong-hyuk's Reference to 'President's Mental State' Is a Childish, Contemptible, and Unprecedented Outrageous Remark" (민주당 “장동혁 대표 ‘대통령 정신세계’ 언급, 유치 졸렬한 역대급 망언”)
item.description:
Democratic Party: "Representative Jang Dong-hyuk's Reference to 'President's Mental State' Is a Childish, Contemptible, and Unprecedented Outrageous Remark" (민주당 “장동혁 대표 ‘대통령 정신세계’ 언급, 유치 졸렬한 역대급 망언”)

<<>> Han Byung-do, the acting leader and floor leader of the Democratic Party of Korea, pushed back on Thursday against People Power Party Representative Jang Dong-hyuk, calling his comment "an outrageous remark" after Jang said he was "curious about the mental state" of President Lee Jae-myung, who allegedly had not read the revised Criminal Procedure Act. ()

At the party's supreme council meeting that day, Representative Jang referenced a news report stating that President Lee had said he had not read the revised Criminal Procedure Act, and remarked, "It's like ordering a double portion of jjamppong, drinking all the broth, and then asking, 'What did I just eat?'" He added, "I'm curious about President Lee's mental state." (한병도 더불어민주당 대표 직무대행 겸 원내대표는 6일 장동혁 국민의힘 대표가 개정 형사소송법을 읽어보지 않았다는 이재명 대통령에 대해 “정신세계가 궁금하다”고 한 것을 두고 “망언”이라고 반발했다.)

In response, Floor Leader Han wrote on Facebook, "Representative Jang is cherry-picking a few remarks from the president's work briefing to wage a gutter-level political attack." He continued, "After holding up a sign saying 'Jae-myung, come fight me' to the president, he's now even bringing up the president's 'mental state.'" Han expressed "deep regret over the continuous foul language and outrageous remarks from the leader of the main opposition party," and warned, "If such behavior repeats, the Democratic Party will no longer sit idly by." (장 대표는 이날 최고위원회의에서 이 대통령이 개정 형사소송법을 읽어보지 않았다고 발언한 기사를 언급하며 “짬뽕을 곱빼기로 시켜놓고 국물까지 다 마시고 나서 내가 지금 뭐 먹었냐고 물어보는 것이냐”며 “이 대통령의 정신세계가 궁금하다”고 했다.)

He added, "As the overall person in charge of state affairs, President Lee is fully aware of the overall intent and core contents of the Criminal Procedure Act revision," and noted, "The remarks Representative Jang is taking issue with are an extremely fragmentary part that came up in the process of asking questions from the public's perspective." He went on to say, "Picking fights with self-serving interpretations while omitting all context is a childish and contemptible political offensive," and stressed, "Playing political games for partisan interests alone cannot protect the safety of the people." (이에 대해 한 원내대표는 페이스북 글에서 “장 대표가 대통령 업무보고 중 일부 발언만 떼어내 막장 정치공세를 펴고 있다”며 “대통령에게 ‘재명아 나랑 싸우자’ 팻말을 들더니 이제는 대통령의 ‘정신세계’까지 입에 올렸다”고 했다. 한 원내대표는 “연일 이어지는 제1야당 대표의 막말과 망언에 깊은 유감을 표한다”며 “앞으로 이런 일이 반복된다면 민주당은 더 이상 좌시하지 않겠다”고 했다.)

Floor Leader Han stated, "The Democratic Party will push through the People Power Party's tantrums and complete a criminal justice system that serves only the people," adding, "The Democratic Party and the government will make thorough preparations, including follow-up legislative adjustments and budget allocations, to ensure the new criminal justice system takes root stably by October 2." (그는 “이 대통령은 국정 총책임자로 형사소송법 개정의 전반적 취지와 핵심 내용을 충분히 숙지하고 있다”며 “장 대표가 문제 삼는 발언은 국민 시각에서 질문하는 과정에 나온 극히 단편적 일부”라고 했다. 이어 “전후 맥락을 모두 생략한 채 아전인수적으로 트집 잡는 행태는 유치하고 졸렬한 정치공세”라며 “당리당략에 따진 정치공세만으로는 국민 안전을 지킬 수 없다”고 했다.)

Senior Spokesperson Kang Joon-hyun also condemned Representative Jang's remark that day in a written briefing, calling it "an unprecedented outrageous remark" and demanding "an immediate apology." (한 원내대표는 “민주당은 국민의힘의 몽니를 뚫고 오직 국민을 위한 형사사법 체계를 완성하겠다”며 “민주당과 정부는 10월 2일 새로운 형사사법 체계가 안정적으로 정착될 수 있도록 후속 법령 정비와 예산 확보에 완벽히 하겠다”고 했다.)

Senior Spokesperson Kang said, "On June 24, after the local elections, Representative Jang refused to step down, drawing a line by saying, 'The party leadership's fate is a matter for party members to decide.' Now he is thoroughly ignoring and disparaging the resignation demands of 24,000 party members," and asked, "Is Representative Jang's mental state fully intact?" He added, "Representative Jang should drop the idea of dragging the president in to escape the crisis and first clearly state his position on the party members' demands for his resignation." (강준현 수석대변인도 이날 서면 브리핑에서 장 대표의 해당 발언은 “역대급 망언”이라며 “즉각 사과하라”고 했다.)

item.title: Through 37-Degree Heatwave... US Marines Conduct First Drone Live-Fire Exercise on Korean Peninsula (37도 폭염 뚫고... 美해병대 한반도 첫 드론 사격)
item.description:
Through 37-Degree Heatwave... US Marines Conduct First Drone Live-Fire Exercise on Korean Peninsula (37도 폭염 뚫고... 美해병대 한반도 첫 드론 사격)

On the 5th, at the Rodriguez Live-Fire Range in Yeongpyeong-ri, Yeongjung-myeon, Pocheon, Gyeonggi Province, where the maximum temperature exceeded 37 degrees Celsius, a low voice saying "Splash" came through the radio. A red flash erupted at a target approximately 2.5 km from the command post, and about three seconds later, an explosion was heard. This was the scene of the US Marine Corps' first live-fire exercise with first-person view (FPV) attack drones on the Korean Peninsula, conducted on the 5th. This marks the first time the US military has publicly revealed a drone live-fire exercise conducted within the country to the media, which is unprecedented. <<> On that day, Marines from the 7th Regiment of the 3rd Marine Division, participating in the Korea Marine Exchange Program (KMEP) training with South Korean Marines, conducted a live-fire exercise with the quadcopter-type suicide drone 'Neros Archer.' The first launch took place at approximately 4:33 PM, and all six drones hit targets located about 0.9 km away. These are 'Hit-to-Kill' suicide drones that directly strike targets, and precise guidance was possible through the drone's onboard camera up to the moment of impact. The flight process could also be observed in real-time from the drone's perspective via a terminal device. <<> The Neros Archer drone, known to cost around 7 million won per unit, has a maximum range of 25 km, a top speed of 130 km/h, and a payload capacity of about 3 kg. It has four propellers and measures 30–40 cm in length and width, roughly the size of a backpack. It can carry anti-tank, anti-material, and anti-personnel warheads. The anti-tank munition is said to have destructive power capable of penetrating 100 mm of standard tank armor. The US Marine Corps reportedly utilizes this drone as a weapon system capable of long-range reconnaissance and precision strikes from beyond 20 km, exceeding the range of infantry rifle squad and platoon organic weapon systems. This appears to take into account that the 60 mm and 81 mm mortars operated by US Marine Corps and Republic of Korea Army small units have a range of just 3–5 km and lower accuracy than FPV drones. The Neros Archer has received the US Department of Defense's 'Blue UAS' certification and is used by the US Army and Marine Corps, meaning it contains almost no Chinese-made components. It has also been deployed in quantities of over 6,000 units to Ukraine, which is at war with Russia. <<> Peter Ankney, Deputy Commander of US Marine Corps Forces Korea (Colonel), met with reporters on that day and stated, "The core of everything is (ROK-US) combined readiness," adding, "The very fact that US Marines can traverse the terrain of the Korean Peninsula, where they could actually be deployed in the future, and showcase these capabilities is a great opportunity." The exercise on that day was conducted by Marines from the 7th Regiment of the 3rd Marine Division, who are not normally stationed on the Korean Peninsula, having temporarily deployed for training purposes. This signifies an effort to strengthen operational capabilities in the event of a contingency requiring US Marine Corps deployment to the Korean Peninsula. Taking advantage of this KMEP, the US Marine Corps is conducting its first-ever suicide drone live-fire exercise on the Korean Peninsula. <<> On the 5th, a 'Heat Wave Severe Warning' was issued across most of the country, including Pocheon. The firing, originally planned for 3 PM, was delayed by about 1 hour and 30 minutes due to safety procedure compliance, but proceeded as scheduled despite the deadly heat. A US Marine Corps official stated, "We don't control the weather on the battlefield," and added, "Experiencing not only Korea's unique terrain but also the high heat and humidity of Korean summers and the extreme cold of winters is a valuable opportunity." (최고기온이 37도를 웃돌았던 5일 경기 포천 영중면 영평리 로드리게스 사격장에서 무전기 너머로 스플래시(Splash)라는 낮은 목소리가 들려왔다. 지휘소에서 약 2.5㎞ 떨어진 목표물에서 붉은 섬광이 일었고, 3초가량 지나자 폭음이 들려왔다. 5일 미 해병대가 한반도에서 처음으로 실시한 1인칭 시점(FPV) 공격 무인기 실사격 훈련 현장이었다. 미군이 국내에서 실시한 드론 실사격 훈련을 언론에 공개한 것은 이번이 처음으로 이례적이다.)

item.title: Ulchi Exercise to Be Held Nationwide from 18th to 21st... Training for Responding to Damage to Core Infrastructure (18~21일 전국서 을지연습… 핵심 인프라 피해 대응 훈련)
item.description:
Ulchi Exercise to Be Held Nationwide from 18th to 21st... Training for Responding to Damage to Core Infrastructure (18~21일 전국서 을지연습… 핵심 인프라 피해 대응 훈련)

The government held a meeting on the 6th to review the preparation status of the Ulchi Exercise, a training program designed to prepare for a total national crisis, and decided to focus this year's exercise on response training based on scenarios of damage to national core infrastructure and real-time defense training simulating cyber attacks. (정부가 6일 국가 총력전 상황에 대비하는 훈련인 을지연습의 준비 상황을 점검하는 회의를 열고, 올해 을지연습에서는 국가 핵심 기반 시설이 피해를 본 상황을 가정한 대응 훈련과 사이버 공격이 들어오는 상황을 가정한 실시간 방어 훈련을 중점적으로 하기로 했다.)

The Office of the Prime Minister announced on the same afternoon that the 2026 Ulchi Exercise preparation report meeting, chaired by Prime Minister Han Sung-sook at the Government Complex Seoul, made this decision. The meeting was attended by the heads of all central administrative agencies, mayors and provincial governors, senior officials from the Constitutional Court and the National Election Commission, and top military officials. (국무총리실은 이날 오후 정부서울청사에서 한성숙 국무총리가 주재하는 2026년도 을지연습 준비 보고 회의를 열어 이같이 결정했다고 밝혔다. 회의에는 모든 중앙행정기관장과 시·도지사, 헌법재판소·중앙선거관리위원회 고위 관계자와 군 최고위 간부들이 참석했다.)

The Ulchi Exercise is a national emergency preparedness training conducted at the government level across the country, aimed at protecting the lives and property of citizens in the event of war, insurrection, or a comparable national emergency. It is held once a year in conjunction with the ROK-U.S. combined exercise, and this year it will run for four days and three nights from the 18th to the 21st. Approximately 580,000 people from about 4,000 locations, including administrative agencies above the eup, myeon, and dong level, public institutions and organizations, and key managed companies, are expected to participate. (을지연습은 전시·사변 또는 이에 준하는 국가 비상사태가 일어났을 때 국민의 생명과 재산을 보호하는 것을 목표로 정부 차원에서 전국 단위로 실시하는 비상 대비 훈련이다. 한미 연합 연습과 연계해 매년 1회 실시되고, 올해는 오는 18일부터 21일까지 3박 4일간 진행된다. 읍·면·동 이상의 행정기관과 공공기관·단체, 중점 관리 대상 업체 등 4000여 곳에서 58만여 명이 참여할 예정이다.)

Prime Minister Han said, "The security environment has been changing rapidly in recent years," adding, "The Russia-Ukraine war and armed conflicts in the Middle East show that modern warfare can go beyond military clashes to directly threaten national core infrastructure and the daily lives of citizens." He also noted, "New forms of threats, such as artificial intelligence (AI), drones, and cyber attacks, are also becoming a reality." (한 총리는 “최근 안보 환경이 빠르게 변화하고 있다”며 “러시아·우크라이나 전쟁과 중동 지역의 무력 충돌은 현대전이 군사적 충돌을 넘어 국가 핵심 기반 시설과 국민의 일상까지 직접 위협할 수 있음을 보여 주고 있다”고 했다. “인공지능(AI), 드론, 사이버 공격 등 새로운 형태의 위협도 현실화하고 있다”고 했다.)

Prime Minister Han said, "In this security environment, the government's response capability must encompass not only support for military operations but also the maintenance of citizens' daily lives and the continuity of state functions," and urged, "Please actively reflect threat factors such as AI, drones, cyber attacks, and complex disasters into the exercise scenarios and prepare so that training can be more realistic and effective." (한 총리는 “이런 안보 환경에서 정부의 대응 역량은 군사 작전 지원뿐 아니라 국민의 일상 유지와 국가 기능 지속까지 포괄해야 한다”며 “AI와 드론, 사이버 공격, 복합 재난 등 위협 요인을 연습 시나리오에 적극 반영해 보다 현실적이고 실효성 있는 훈련이 이뤄질 수 있도록 준비해 달라”고 당부했다.)

He also said, "Each agency should conduct actual resident-participatory drills and promote them through various channels, making active efforts so that citizens can learn emergency action guidelines." (또 “각 기관은 주민 참여형 실제 훈련을 실시하고 홍보를 다각도로 추진해, 국민이 비상시 행동 요령을 익힐 수 있도록 적극 노력해 달라”고 했다.)

He further stated, "As this year's Ulchi Exercise is the first to be held after the government reorganization and the local administrative system reform, each agency should realign its emergency response system in line with the new work structure and ensure that it operates without disruption in real situations." (“올해 을지연습은 정부 조직 개편과 지방 행정 체계 개편 이후 처음 실시되는 것인 만큼, 각 기관은 새로운 업무 체계에 맞춰 비상 대응 체계를 정비하고, 실제 상황에서도 차질 없이 작동할 수 있도록 해 달라”고도 했다.)

In this year's Ulchi Exercise, the government decided to have each agency conduct one training session based on scenarios in which national core infrastructure—such as power and energy facilities, airports, ports, and roads—has been damaged. In addition, the National Intelligence Service will oversee a joint real-time cyber defense exercise involving the government, the military, and related agencies. (정부는 이번 을지연습에서 전력·에너지 시설과 공항·항만·도로 등 국가 핵심 기반 시설이 피해를 본 상황을 가정해 기관당 1훈련을 실시하도록 하고, 이와 별도로 국가정보원 주관으로 정부와 군, 관계 기관이 합동해 실시간 사이버 방어 훈련을 실시하기로 했다.)

To expand the responsibility and role of agency heads, each agency head will directly lead the training and participate in wartime task discussions and situation response drills. A new 'Ulchi Meeting of Ministers' chaired by the Deputy Prime Minister for Economy, Science and Technology will also be established. (또 기관장의 책임과 역할을 확대하기 위해, 각 기관장이 훈련을 직접 주관하도록 하고, 전시 과제 토의와 상황 조치 훈련에도 직접 참여하도록 했다. 경제·과학기술부총리가 주재하는 ‘을지 관계 장관 회의’도 신설된다.)

As in previous years, the exercise will also include emergency recall drills for all public officials, the formation of wartime-established organizations, integrated government-military situation response exercises, and an Ulchi State Council meeting to master wartime transition procedures. On the 20th, a nationwide civil defense drill for air raid preparedness, open to all citizens, will be conducted. This will involve actual practice of resident evacuation, clearing emergency vehicle routes, and traffic control. (전 공무원 비상 소집 훈련, 전시 창설 기구 편성, 정부·군 통합 상황 대응 연습, 전시 전환 절차 숙달을 위한 을지 국무회의도 예년처럼 실시된다. 오는 20일에는 전 국민이 참여할 수 있는 전국 단위 공습 대비 민방위 훈련이 실시된다. 주민 대피, 긴급 차량 길 터주기, 차량 통제 등을 실제로 연습한다.)

Prime Minister Han said, "I ask the public to actively cooperate with the guidance of relevant agencies during the training period and to participate in the air raid civil defense drill to directly practice national action guidelines." To the agency heads, she said, "If you lead the exercise by setting an example, this Ulchi Exercise will serve as an opportunity to strengthen the national emergency preparedness posture and earn greater trust from the public." (한 총리는 “국민 여러분께서도 훈련 기간 관계 기관의 안내에 적극 협조해 주시고, 공습 단위 민방위 훈련에도 함께 참여해 국민 행동 요령을 직접 실천해 주시기를 부탁드린다”고 했다. 기관장들에게도 “여러분이 솔선수범해 연습을 이끌어 주신다면, 이번 을지연습은 국가 비상 대비 태세를 강화하고 국민께 더욱 큰 신뢰를 드릴 수 있는 계기가 될 것”이라고 했다.)

item.title: Unification Ministry Responds to Criticism of Revealing Differences with Foreign Ministry: "Did We Reveal Differences?" (통일부, 외교부와의 이견 노출 지적에 “이견 저희가 노출했나?”)
item.description:
Unification Ministry Responds to Criticism of Revealing Differences with Foreign Ministry: "Did We Reveal Differences?" (통일부, 외교부와의 이견 노출 지적에 “이견 저희가 노출했나?”)

The Unification Ministry said on the 6th, in response to Foreign Minister Cho Tae-yul's public dismissal of Unification Minister Kim Young-ho's "Korean Peninsula Peaceful Coexistence Development Initiative" as "idealistic" the previous day, that "It is not idealism but the most realistic and practical approach at this point in time." (통일부는 6일 조현 외교부 장관이 전날 정동영 통일부 장관이 추진하는 ‘한반도 평화공존 발전 구상’을 놓고 “이상주의적”이라고 공개적으로 평가절하한데 대해 “이상주의가 아니라 지금 시점에서 가장 현실적이고 실용적인 방안”이라고 했다.)

The Unification Ministry said on the same day, "We will continue our efforts for peaceful coexistence on the Korean Peninsula with patience until results are achieved," adding, "However, in the current situation, several times more effort is needed to create peace," and "If we stay still, nothing will happen, so we must act." (통일부는 이날 “인내를 가지고 성과 나올때까지 한반도 평화공존을 위한 노력을 계속하겠다”며 “그러나 지금과 같은 상황에서는 평화를 만들기 위해 몇배의 노력이 필요하다”면서 “가만히 있으면 아무 일도 일어나지 않으니 움직여야 한다”고 했다.)

A Unification Ministry official, meeting with reporters on the same day, responded to the exposure of differences between the Unification Ministry and the Foreign Ministry by saying, "Did we reveal the differences?" and "We will continue to promote the peaceful coexistence policy consistently as we have been doing, while closely consulting with relevant ministries such as the Foreign Ministry." (통일부 당국자는 이날 기자들과 만나 통일부와 외교부 간 이견이 노출된데 대해 “이견 노출을 저희가 한거냐”며 “저희는 해왔던 대로 평화 공존 정책 일관되게 추진하는 과정에서 외교부 등 관계부처와 긴밀히 협의해나갈 것”이라고 했다.)

Regarding the push to restore the September 19 military agreement, which President Lee Jae-myung questioned the previous day about whether it helps peace on the Korean Peninsula, the Unification Ministry said, "While keeping the President's remarks in mind, although it is a difficult task, we will deliberate and push forward with the restoration of the military agreement through sufficient consultation with relevant ministries such as the Ministry of National Defense." The President had said the previous day, "Since taking office, I pushed for the restoration of the September 19 agreement, but as the situation has not continued to improve, reactions have emerged asking whether this is a unilateral concession or an abandonment of security, and progress has been slow. I sometimes have doubts about whether following our goodwill truly adds to peace and stability on the Korean Peninsula." (통일부는 전날 이재명 대통령이 한반도 평화에 도움이 되는지 의문을 제기한 9·19 군사합의 복원 추진과 관련해 “대통령님 말씀 유념하면서 어려운 일이지만 고민하고 국방부 등 관계부처와 충분히 협의하면서 군사합의 복원을 추진해나가겠다”고 했다. 이 대통령은 전날 “제가 취임하면서 9·19 합의 복원을 추진했지만 상황은 계속 개선 안되다보니까 일방적으로 양보하는거냐, 안보를 포기하는 거냐 이런 반응들이 생겨나기도 하고 진척도 잘 안되고 우리의 선의대로 하는게 과연 한반도의 평화와 안정에 플러스냐, 결론적으로 약간의 의문이 들때도 있다”고 했다.)

Regarding the issue of how to designate North Korea, for which the President advised a "cautious approach," the Unification Ministry said, "Rather than the Unification Ministry getting ahead of itself, we have nothing more to say beyond our position of supporting public discourse." The President had said the previous day about the proposal to call North Korea by its official country name, "Using the official names of the two Koreas is a matter of debate. We have good values and ideals, but if we get caught up in bickering over expressions and it turns into political strife, it could lead to a worse situation than what we originally intended. Of course, asserting contentious points does have the effect of broadening the horizon of social discussion. But we really need to think carefully about it." (통일부는 이 대통령이 ‘신중한 접근’을 당부한 북한 호칭 문제에 대해서도 “통일부가 앞서나간다기 보다는 공론화를 뒷받침하겠다는 입장 이상으로 드릴 말씀이 없다”고 했다. 이 대통령은 전날 북한을 정식 국호로 부르자는 제안에 대해 “남북한 공식 명칭을 부르는 일은 논쟁의 여지가 있는 일”이라며 “우리가 좋은 가치와 이상을 갖고 있지만 이게 뭔가 표현에 꼬투리가 잡혀서 정쟁으로 들어가면 원래 하고자 했던데서 오히려 나쁜 상황이 초래될 수도 있겠다”며 “물론 논쟁거리를 주장하면서 (사회적 논의의) 지평이 넓어지는 효과는 또 있다. 그런데 정말로 잘 고민해야 될 것 같다”고 했다.)

item.title: 46 Former Army, Navy, and Air Force Chiefs of Staff Strongly Recommend Reconsidering Military Academy Integration (前 육·해·공군총장 46명 “사관학교 통합 재검토 강력 건의”)
item.description:
Forty-six former Chiefs of Staff of the Army, Navy, and Air Force opposed the establishment of the "National Defense Academy," which merges the three service academies, and urged a policy reconsideration on the 6th. (육·해·공군의 역대 참모총장 46명이 6일 육·해·공군 3군 사관학교를 통폐합한 ‘국군사관학교’ 창설에 반대하며 정책 재검토를 촉구했다.)

In a statement released on the 6th, the former Chiefs of Staff group said, "Generalizing the political involvement of some soldiers from a particular academy to the entire alumni body, and further proposing the integration of the three service academies as a preventive measure, is a mismatch between diagnosis and prescription," adding, "Those who participated in illegal acts should be held strictly accountable, but the development of the academies should be discussed based on the essence of national security and the cultivation of elite officers." They further urged, "What matters more than the physical integration of the academies is what kind of officers the Republic of Korea will produce," and called for "fundamental development plans that allow outstanding talent to choose the military while simultaneously advancing each service's expertise and jointness." <<> The statement was signed by a total of 46 individuals: 18 former Army Chiefs of Staff, 13 former Navy Chiefs of Staff, and 15 former Air Force Chiefs of Staff. Among them, 26—including 9 from the Army, 6 from the Navy, and 11 from the Air Force—attended a meeting held the previous day at the Air Force Hotel in Seoul. The Chiefs of Staff group stated, "The statement is not intended to criticize the government or express a political stance, but to convey to the public and the government the professional views of those who have served as the military's top commanders on a policy that has long-term implications for national security." <<> The former Chiefs of Staff argued that the government has failed to concretely demonstrate the necessity of academy integration. They said, "Each service academy has steadily produced officers with the unique identity and expertise of its respective service over a long period," and "Jointness is exercised based on each service's unique expertise, not by simply educating them together in the same place." This refutes the Ministry of National Defense's push for integrating the three service academies under the rationale of "strengthening jointness." However, President Lee Jae-myung said on the 5th, "All military coups in the Republic of Korea were instigated by the Army, by graduates of the Korea Military Academy," and "Integration would reduce the likelihood of this." This suggests that academy integration is needed more for "preventing coups" than for strengthening jointness, a stance somewhat different in tone from the arguments previously made by Defense Minister Ahn Kyu-baek and the Ministry. <<> The government and the Democratic Party of Korea announced a basic plan last month to establish the National Defense Academy by integrating the Army, Navy, and Air Force academies at Jaun-dae, Daejeon. The Ministry of National Defense has argued that integration is essential to address the decline in the school-age population, eliminate redundancy in facilities and faculty, strengthen jointness, and prepare for future warfare. However, unlike President Lee, the Ministry has never cited "coup prevention" as a reason for integration thus far. (역대 참모총장단은 6일 입장문을 내고 “특정 사관학교 출신 일부 군인들의 정치개입을 출신학교 전체의 문제로 일반화하고, 나아가 삼군 사관학교 통합을 그 예방책으로 제시하는 것은 진단과 처방이 어긋나는 것”이라며 “불법행위에 가담한 자에게는 엄정하게 책임을 묻되, 사관학교 발전은 국가안보와 정예장교 양성이라는 본질에 따라 논의해야 한다”고 했다. 그러면서 “사관학교의 물리적 통합 여부보다 중요한 것은 대한민국이 어떤 장교를 길러낼 것인가”라며 “각 군의 전문성과 합동성을 함께 발전시키면서 우수한 인재가 군을 선택할 수 있는 근본적인 발전방안을 마련해 달라”고 촉구했다.)

The following are the former Chiefs of Staff who signed the statement. (이번 입장문에는 역대 육군참모총장 18명과 해군참모총장 13명, 공군참모총장 15명 등 모두 46명이 이름을 올렸다. 이들 가운데 육군 9명과 해군 6명, 공군 11명 등 26명은 전날 서울 공군호텔에서 열린 간담회에 직접 참석했다. 총장단 측은 “입장문은 정부를 비판하거나 정치적 입장을 표명하기 위한 것이 아니라, 국가안보에 장기적인 영향을 미치는 정책에 대해 군 최고 지휘관을 역임한 사람들의 전문적 견해를 국민과 정부에 전달하기 위한 것”이라고 했다.)

△Army = Lee Jong-gu (KMA Class 14), Lee Jin-sam (Class 15), Kim Jin-young (Class 17), Kim Dong-jin (Class 17), Do Il-gyu (Class 20), Kim Pan-gyu (Class 24), Nam Jae-joon (Class 25), Park Heung-ryeol (Class 28), Lim Chung-bin (Class 29), Han Min-goo (Class 31), Hwang Eui-don (Class 31), Kim Sang-ki (Class 32), Jo Jung-hwan (Class 33), Kwon Oh-sung (Class 34), Kim Yo-hwan (Class 34), Jang Jun-gyu (Class 36), Kim Yong-woo (Class 39), Park Jung-hwan (Class 44) (역대 총장단은 정부가 사관학교 통합의 필요성을 구체적으로 입증하지 못했다고 주장했다. 이들은 “각 군 사관학교는 오랜 기간 각 군 고유의 정체성과 전문성을 갖춘 장교를 안정적으로 양성해 왔다”라며 “합동성은 각 군 고유의 전문성을 바탕으로 발휘되는 것이지 동일한 장소에서 함께 교육한다고 발휘되는 것이 아니다”라고 했다. 국방부는 그동안 ‘합동성 강화’를 명분으로 3군 사관학교 통합을 추진했는데 이를 반박한 것이다. 다만 이재명 대통령은 5일 “대한민국 군사 쿠데타는 다 육군에서 벌어진 일, 육사 출신들이 한 일”이라며 “통합을 하면 이럴 가능성이 줄어든다”고 했다. 합동성 강화보다는 ‘쿠데타 예방’을 위해서는 사관학교 통합이 필요하다는 취지로, 그동안 안규백 국방장관 및 국방부의 주장과는 다소 결을 달리하는 내용이다.)

△Navy = Yoo Sam-nam (NA Class 18), Lee Soo-yong (Class 20), Jang Jung-gil (Class 21), Moon Jung-il (Class 23), Nam Hae-il (Class 26), Kim Sung-chan (Class 30), Choi Yoon-hee (Class 31), Eom Hyun-sung (Class 35), Shim Seung-seop (Class 39), Kim Jung-soo (Class 41), Lee Jong-ho (Class 42), Yang Yong-mo (Class 44), Kang Dong-gil (Class 46) (정부와 더불어민주당은 지난달 대전 자운대에 육·해·공군사관학교를 통합한 국군사관학교를 창설하겠다는 취지의 기본계획을 발표했다. 국방부는 학령인구 감소와 시설·교수진 중복 해소, 합동성 강화, 미래전 대비 등을 위해서는 통합이 필수적이라고 주장해왔다. 다만 국방부는 이 대통령과 달리 지금까지 ‘쿠데타 예방’을 통합 이유로 밝힌 적은 없다.)

item.title: [Breaking News] JCS: "North Korea Fires Unidentified Projectile into East Sea" ([속보] 합참 “北, 동해상으로 미상 발사체 발사”)
item.description:
[Breaking News] JCS: "North Korea Fires Unidentified Projectile into East Sea" ([속보] 합참 “北, 동해상으로 미상 발사체 발사”)

The Joint Chiefs of Staff announced that North Korea fired an unidentified projectile into the East Sea on the 6th. The JCS is analyzing the specifications and range of the North Korean projectile. (북한이 6일 동해상으로 미상 발사체를 발사했다고 합동참모본부가 밝혔다. 합참은 북한 발사체의 제원과 사거리 등을 분석 중이다.)

If the North Korean projectile is confirmed as a ballistic missile, it would be the first launch in 42 days. (북한 발사체가 탄도미사일로 확인되면 42일 만의 발사다.)

In related news, according to Japan's NHK, Japan's Ministry of Defense announced that an object possibly a ballistic missile was launched from North Korea on this day. (이와 관련, 일본 NHK에 따르면 일본 방위성은 이날 북한에서 탄도미사일일 가능성이 있는 물체가 발사됐다고 발표했다.)

Earlier, on June 25, North Korea conducted test launches of tactical weapons within striking range of the South, including tactical ballistic missiles, extended-range 155mm self-propelled howitzer shells, and upgraded 240mm 24-barrel multiple rocket launchers, under the observation of Chairman Kim Jong-un. (앞서 북한은 지난 6월 25일 김정은 국무위원장이 참관하는 가운데 전술탄도미사일, 155㎜ 자주포 사거리 연장탄, 갱신형 240㎜ 24관식 방사포 등 남측을 사정권에 두는 전술무기 발사 실험을 했다.)

On the 3rd of last month, North Korea conducted a test launch of a strategic cruise missile mounted on its new 5,000-ton-class destroyer, the "Ganggeon-ho." (북한은 지난달 3일엔 신형 5천t급 구축함 ‘강건호’에 탑재된 전략순항미사일 시험발사를 했다.)
